en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a two‑storey stone building labeled as a hotel, with an attached lower wing. The architecture features masonry walls, arched ground‑floor openings, and a small central balcony. In the foreground there is a pile of stones or rubble beside an unpaved street. The card has printed captions in German‑style script at the top and along the left margin, and wide blank margins typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
